m_intro: is an exciting dice game played with three dice. The players place bets and predict the total points of the three dice are BIG or SMALL.
m_winning_condition_l1: The player can bet on either BIG or SMALL, but not on both.
m_winning_condition_l2: BIG: the total points of three dice >= 11
m_winning_condition_l3: SMALL: the total points of the three dice <= 10
m_winning_condition_l4: Balanced Betting Pool: if the total amounts bet on BIG and SMALL are different then the gap amount will be refunded to the players who have the latest bet ticket.
m_winning_condition_l5: Player A bets 100 on BIG, player B bets 40 on SMALL, and C bets 80 on SMALL. To balance the total amounts bet on BIG and SMALL, the system will refund 20 to player C.
m_bet_limit_l1: Min bet and Max bet must be between {{minBet}} - {{maxBet}} and the maximum total stake per round is {{maxBet}}
